description: This Java class implements a log filtering node that passes through only the message content, removing metadata like priority, tags, and exceptions. It is used in log chaining for Android applications to simplify log output.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters out all log metadata, passing only the message to the next node in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode to chain outputs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides LogNode's println method to pass only the message content to the next node, ignoring other log parameters.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
